_comment: Merge into a composed checkout's .claude/settings.json (folio-assistant, or any index that mounts cat-harness-tools at cat-harness-tools/). It refuses an agent's `git commit` or `git push` that would wipe a state branch (scripts/state-write-guard.ts), and runs the fast gates before a `git push`, blocking it only on a new failure (scripts/pre-push-gates.ts, bean cat-tools-pp9g). The `[ ! -f ]` guard keeps it a no-op in a checkout whose cat-harness-tools pin predates the hook. For cat-harness-tools checked out on its own, the path is scripts/git-hooks/claude-pre-push.sh.
